persistent_goal.rule: After every accepted atomic batch, immediately select the next safe eligible Base-native product or engineering batch. Calendar, status readback, tests and unchanged upstream observations are not stop conditions while safe local work exists.
persistent_goal.zero_delta_failure: Planning-only, audit-only, unchanged readback or status narration counts as zero_delta_failure and the exact batch must be redispatched.

supervision.healthy_rule: If the owning Session is active and producing all three deltas, remain quiet.
supervision.recovery_rule: If idle, stopped, or zero-delta, redispatch the exact current batch. Diagnose one blocker once, persist it, then rotate to the next safe eligible batch.

p6.base_use: independently reviewed product input only; create a separate Base eight-surface readiness candidate and require current official readback plus 02_Build revalidation; no external authority or completion claim is inherited

excluded_from_sync: Arc/Circle chain semantics and runtime counters
Circle Console or Encode publication claims
promotion_gates: The delta has a stable source path, immutable reviewed inputs and a declared Base write set.
Arc network, wallet, Circle Console and chain assumptions are removed or quarantined.
Base official network, Base Account/Smart Wallet, x402, B20, receipt and finality semantics are revalidated.
Existing Base-native tests remain green and new behavior has focused reproducible tests.
03_Base creates one typed candidate packet; fresh independent Sol/medium accepts it before 02_Build consumption.
No upstream file directly overwrites Base release identity, daily runtime, queue, counters, owner gate or publication evidence.

base_evidence_strictness.counted_chain_transaction: Primary Base Account/Smart Wallet, unique Base Mainnet state change, wallet_getCallsStatus confirmed, receipt status 0x1, target and semantics bound, configured finality satisfied, dedup and replay lock passed.
base_evidence_strictness.testnet: Base Sepolia and Vibenet are product/test evidence only and never count toward the daily 30.
base_evidence_strictness.business_boundary: Chain success never implies ERP posting, business close or publication-platform attribution.
base_evidence_strictness.publication_unit: All eight Base platforms must prove the same current release_id, fingerprint and BOM; historical or partial receipts count zero.

invalidation: Any upstream change after a captured delta requires a new review packet; never silently recopy the mutable CIRCLE working tree.
